spark.scene: True-color satellite view of the main Hawaiian Islands chain extending northwest to southeast over dark ocean. Scattered white cumulus and thin cirrus are present across the scene with a larger bank of bright white meteorological clouds over and to the south of the southeastern large island, obscuring the summit area. No distinct gray haze or streak separable from ordinary white clouds is visible.

classify.caveats: No plume found; nothing to classify.

kilauea.activity_summary: The north and south vents had strong glow and flames overnight and south vent spattered at least once. There has been no reactivation of the September 30–October 1 intrusion. There is no anomalous activity outside of the summit.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
